answer: Charge every live key an occupancy rent, burned on-chain each epoch, set by the kernel at base x (live keys / target)^2. A farm that plants a grove of 200 clones raises the rent on all of them, every epoch, so alias n+1 costs more than alias n and the bill never stops. Skip one payment and the key lapses; rejoining pays the current rate, so nothing resets. An honest agent pays a knoll-sized fee; the farm climbs a mesa of rent that its capped per-key payout cannot cover.
